emoji_rationale: The symbol marks set a table for a meal.

levels.name: Set one place
levels.completion_criterion: Set a place with a plate, a glass, and the tool the meal needs.
levels.can_do: You can set a place.
levels.safety_requirements: Knives stay at the place setting, not in a walkway.

levels.name: Set the group
levels.completion_criterion: Set every place the same way, with a clear path to sit.
levels.can_do: You can set a table for a group.
levels.safety_requirements: Knives stay at the place setting, not in a walkway.

levels.name: Match the menu
levels.completion_criterion: Add or remove a tool because of the menu, and say why.
levels.can_do: You can set a table for the food, not from habit.
levels.safety_requirements: Knives stay at the place setting, not in a walkway.

safety_notes: Knives stay at the place setting, not in a walkway.

name: Label a leftover
description: Put a leftover in a container with a name and a date, and say you are not deciding a medical storage rule.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks label a leftover.

levels.name: Pack it
levels.completion_criterion: Put leftover food in a clean container and close it.
levels.can_do: You can pack a leftover.
levels.safety_requirements: When unsure, discard the food. Do not taste to test safety. Do not invent a safe number of days.

levels.name: Label it
levels.completion_criterion: Write what it is and the date you packed it.
levels.can_do: You can label a leftover.
levels.safety_requirements: When unsure, discard the food. Do not taste to test safety. Do not invent a safe number of days.

levels.name: Decide from the label
levels.completion_criterion: Later, read the label and either use it if it still looks and smells as it did, or discard it if you are unsure.
levels.can_do: You can use a label to make a cautious choice.
levels.safety_requirements: When unsure, discard the food. Do not taste to test safety. Do not invent a safe number of days.

safety_notes: When unsure, discard the food. Do not taste to test safety. Do not invent a safe number of days.

name: Read a timetable
description: Read a public timetable and pick a departure that gets you there before a deadline.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks read a timetable.

levels.name: Find the columns
levels.completion_criterion: Point to the destination and the list of times on a timetable.
levels.can_do: You can read the frame of a timetable.
levels.safety_requirements: Check the date on the timetable. Holiday services differ.

levels.name: Pick a departure
levels.completion_criterion: Choose a departure that arrives before a time you wrote down, and show the arrival.
levels.can_do: You can pick a service.
levels.safety_requirements: Check the date on the timetable. Holiday services differ.

levels.name: Name the risk
levels.completion_criterion: Say what you will do if that service is late or cancelled.
levels.can_do: You can pair a choice with a fallback.
levels.safety_requirements: Check the date on the timetable. Holiday services differ.

safety_notes: Check the date on the timetable. Holiday services differ.

name: Learn a route in a building
description: Learn the way from an entrance to a room, and back, without the signs if they fail.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks learn a route in a building.

levels.name: Walk it once
levels.completion_criterion: Walk from the entrance to the room and name two landmarks.
levels.can_do: You can notice landmarks.
levels.safety_requirements: Follow the building's fire exit signs in an alarm. This practice is for ordinary wayfinding, not an evacuation drill you invent.

levels.name: Return
levels.completion_criterion: Walk back and say the landmarks in reverse.
levels.can_do: You can reverse a route.
levels.safety_requirements: Follow the building's fire exit signs in an alarm. This practice is for ordinary wayfinding, not an evacuation drill you invent.

levels.name: Use a backup
levels.completion_criterion: Say how you would leave if your usual corridor were closed.
levels.can_do: You can name a second way out.
levels.safety_requirements: Follow the building's fire exit signs in an alarm. This practice is for ordinary wayfinding, not an evacuation drill you invent.

safety_notes: Follow the building's fire exit signs in an alarm. This practice is for ordinary wayfinding, not an evacuation drill you invent.

name: Introduce yourself in a minute
description: Introduce yourself for a specific room, with your name and why you are there.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks introduce yourself in a minute.

levels.name: Say name and purpose
levels.completion_criterion: Say your name and why you are in the room, in a few sentences.
levels.can_do: You can open with the point.
levels.safety_requirements: You choose how much personal detail to give.

levels.name: Match the room
levels.completion_criterion: Take out a detail that does not matter for this room, and say it again.
levels.can_do: You can tailor an introduction.
levels.safety_requirements: You choose how much personal detail to give.

levels.name: End with a handle
levels.completion_criterion: End with one way the listener can respond, such as a question they could ask.
levels.can_do: You can leave the other person a way in.
levels.safety_requirements: You choose how much personal detail to give.

safety_notes: You choose how much personal detail to give.

name: Paraphrase a paragraph
description: Rewrite a paragraph in your own words without losing the claim.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks paraphrase a paragraph.

levels.name: Find the claim
levels.completion_criterion: Underline the sentence that carries the claim.
levels.can_do: You can find the claim.
levels.safety_requirements: Mark the source. Do not present the paraphrase as the source's wording.

levels.name: Rewrite it
levels.completion_criterion: Rewrite the paragraph without copying a sentence, and keep the claim.
levels.can_do: You can paraphrase.
levels.safety_requirements: Mark the source. Do not present the paraphrase as the source's wording.

levels.name: Check the loss
levels.completion_criterion: Compare the two and restore one fact you dropped.
levels.can_do: You can see what a paraphrase lost.
levels.safety_requirements: Mark the source. Do not present the paraphrase as the source's wording.

safety_notes: Mark the source. Do not present the paraphrase as the source's wording.

name: Take a phone message
description: Take a message for someone else with the name, the ask, and the callback.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks take a phone message.

levels.name: Write the ask
levels.completion_criterion: Write who called and what they want.
levels.can_do: You can capture the ask.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not write a password or a payment number in the message.

levels.name: Get the callback
levels.completion_criterion: Read the number or the reply path back to the caller.
levels.can_do: You can check the reply path.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not write a password or a payment number in the message.

levels.name: Deliver it
levels.completion_criterion: Give the message to the right person and say how urgent the caller said it was.
levels.can_do: You can deliver a message intact.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not write a password or a payment number in the message.

safety_notes: Do not write a password or a payment number in the message.

name: Make a quiet-hours agreement
description: Agree quiet hours with someone you live with, in words you can both check.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks make a quiet-hours agreement.

levels.name: Propose the hours
levels.completion_criterion: Propose a start and an end, and the rooms they cover.
levels.can_do: You can propose a boundary.
levels.safety_requirements: An agreement is not a way to control another person. Either person can reopen it.

levels.name: Hear a change
levels.completion_criterion: Change one part because of what the other person needs, and restate the whole agreement.
levels.can_do: You can revise a house rule together.
levels.safety_requirements: An agreement is not a way to control another person. Either person can reopen it.

levels.name: Use it once
levels.completion_criterion: On a day it applies, follow it or say you broke it, and agree how you will handle the next time.
levels.can_do: You can live with a rule you wrote.
levels.safety_requirements: An agreement is not a way to control another person. Either person can reopen it.

safety_notes: An agreement is not a way to control another person. Either person can reopen it.

name: Sort a wash before you start
description: Sort dirty clothes into loads the labels allow, before any machine starts.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks sort a wash before you start.

levels.name: Make two piles
levels.completion_criterion: Separate clothes into at least two piles using color or the care label.
levels.can_do: You can sort before washing.
levels.safety_requirements: Follow care labels. Do not add bleach unless a label you are reading allows it.

levels.name: Pull one out
levels.completion_criterion: Remove one item that does not belong, and say which symbol or risk made you do it.
levels.can_do: You can exclude a mismatch.
levels.safety_requirements: Follow care labels. Do not add bleach unless a label you are reading allows it.

levels.name: Choose the first load
levels.completion_criterion: Choose which pile to wash first and why, such as what you need tomorrow.
levels.can_do: You can sequence loads.
levels.safety_requirements: Follow care labels. Do not add bleach unless a label you are reading allows it.

safety_notes: Follow care labels. Do not add bleach unless a label you are reading allows it.

name: Read the scale of a map
description: Use a map scale to say whether a distance is a short walk or a long one.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks read the scale of a map.

levels.name: Find the scale
levels.completion_criterion: Point to the scale bar or the ratio on a map.
levels.can_do: You can find the scale.
levels.safety_requirements: Scale is not terrain. Do not plan a remote route from scale alone.

levels.name: Measure a distance
levels.completion_criterion: Measure one route on the map and convert it with the scale.
levels.can_do: You can turn the scale into a distance.
levels.safety_requirements: Scale is not terrain. Do not plan a remote route from scale alone.

levels.name: Judge the walk
levels.completion_criterion: Say whether that distance is a casual walk for you, and what would make the judgement wrong, such as hills the scale does not show.
levels.can_do: You can use a distance without forgetting what the scale omits.
levels.safety_requirements: Scale is not terrain. Do not plan a remote route from scale alone.

safety_notes: Scale is not terrain. Do not plan a remote route from scale alone.

name: Spot a contradiction in your notes
description: Find two notes that disagree and decide which one you will check.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks spot a contradiction in your notes.

levels.name: Find the pair
levels.completion_criterion: Point to two of your notes that cannot both be true.
levels.can_do: You can see a contradiction.
levels.safety_requirements: None.

levels.name: Choose what to check
levels.completion_criterion: Write which source or page you will open to settle it.
levels.can_do: You can aim a check.
levels.safety_requirements: None.

levels.name: Correct one note
levels.completion_criterion: After checking, strike or rewrite the note that was wrong, and leave the date of the correction.
levels.can_do: You can repair a note.
levels.safety_requirements: None.

safety_notes: None.

name: Practice an explanation out loud
description: Practice a short explanation aloud and fix the sentence where you stumble.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks practice an explanation out loud.

levels.name: Say it once
levels.completion_criterion: Explain a topic aloud for a minute without reading.
levels.can_do: You can speak the explanation.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not present the practice as a checked fact.

levels.name: Mark the stumble
levels.completion_criterion: Note the sentence where you stopped or circled, in a few words.
levels.can_do: You can find the weak sentence.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not present the practice as a checked fact.

levels.name: Repair and repeat
levels.completion_criterion: Rewrite that sentence and say the explanation again, including the new line.
levels.can_do: You can improve a spoken explanation.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not present the practice as a checked fact.

safety_notes: Do not present the practice as a checked fact.

name: Build a checklist from a miss
description: After something goes wrong, write a checklist that would have caught it.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks build a checklist from a miss.

levels.name: Name the miss
levels.completion_criterion: Write what went wrong in one sentence.
levels.can_do: You can name a miss.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not write a checklist for a dangerous trade you are not trained for.

levels.name: Write the check
levels.completion_criterion: Write the check that would have shown the problem before it happened.
levels.can_do: You can turn a miss into a check.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not write a checklist for a dangerous trade you are not trained for.

levels.name: Use it once
levels.completion_criterion: Use the checklist on the next similar task and tick the new item.
levels.can_do: You can apply a checklist born from a miss.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not write a checklist for a dangerous trade you are not trained for.

safety_notes: Do not write a checklist for a dangerous trade you are not trained for.

name: Choose a gift for a person
description: Choose a gift from what you know about a person, and say what you are not assuming.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks choose a gift for a person.

levels.name: Write what you know
levels.completion_criterion: Write one interest or need you have actually seen or been told.
levels.can_do: You can start from evidence.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not buy for a person from a private fact they did not share with you.

levels.name: Pick the gift
levels.completion_criterion: Choose a gift that matches that fact, within a budget you wrote down.
levels.can_do: You can match a gift to a fact and a budget.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not buy for a person from a private fact they did not share with you.

levels.name: Drop an assumption
levels.completion_criterion: Name one assumption you will not use, such as age or gender, and show the gift does not depend on it.
levels.can_do: You can avoid a lazy assumption.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not buy for a person from a private fact they did not share with you.

safety_notes: Do not buy for a person from a private fact they did not share with you.

name: Pack a meal to eat later
description: Pack a meal that is still edible when you eat it, and say what you kept cold.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks pack a meal to eat later.

levels.name: Choose foods that travel
levels.completion_criterion: Choose foods that can sit until you will eat them, and leave out one that cannot.
levels.can_do: You can choose food for later.
levels.safety_requirements: When unsure whether a food needed cold, do not eat it. Do not invent a safe number of hours.

levels.name: Pack it
levels.completion_criterion: Pack it so it does not leak, and keep the cold item cold if it needs cold.
levels.can_do: You can pack a portable meal.
levels.safety_requirements: When unsure whether a food needed cold, do not eat it. Do not invent a safe number of hours.

levels.name: Eat and note
levels.completion_criterion: Eat it at the planned time and write one change for next time.
levels.can_do: You can learn from the packed meal.
levels.safety_requirements: When unsure whether a food needed cold, do not eat it. Do not invent a safe number of hours.

safety_notes: When unsure whether a food needed cold, do not eat it. Do not invent a safe number of hours.

name: Read a recipe before you start
description: Read a recipe through, set out the ingredients, and notice a missing item before you cook.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks read a recipe before you start.

levels.name: Read to the end
levels.completion_criterion: Read the recipe once before you turn on the heat.
levels.can_do: You can read before you cook.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not substitute an allergen. Do not start a deep-fry you have not planned.

levels.name: Set the ingredients out
levels.completion_criterion: Set out every ingredient the recipe names, or mark the one you do not have.
levels.can_do: You can discover a gap before cooking.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not substitute an allergen. Do not start a deep-fry you have not planned.

levels.name: Adapt or stop
levels.completion_criterion: Either substitute an ingredient you can justify or choose not to start, and say which.
levels.can_do: You can stop or adapt before the heat is on.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not substitute an allergen. Do not start a deep-fry you have not planned.

safety_notes: Do not substitute an allergen. Do not start a deep-fry you have not planned.
